title: Three variables
description:
Define three variables with these names, types and starting values, then print each on its own line.

| Name | Type | Value |
|---|---|---|
| `age` | `int` | 21 |
| `height` | `double` | 1.75 |
| `grade` | `char` | 'A' |

Expected output:

```
21
1.75
A
```
hints: A definition has three parts: type, name, starting value in braces. For example `double height{ 1.75 };`
To print a variable, send it to `std::cout` without quotes: `std::cout << age << '\n';` With quotes you would print the word "age" instead of its value.
